title: A different schema wearing with-id.schema.json's $id
description: Stands in for the copied built-in whose $id was never changed. Its rules differ from with-id.schema.json — it forbids unknown keys, which that one allows — so whichever compiles first decides the answer. This is the documented cost of keying reuse on $id, and the reason the schema-authoring guide tells readers to change the $id when they copy a schema.
